verses.pali: “Yo kho, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātuyā uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo …pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo;
verses.english: “Mendicants, the arising, continuation, and manifestation and regeneration of the earth element,

verses.pali: yo viññāṇadhātuyā uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
verses.english: and the consciousness element is the arising of suffering, the continuation of diseases, and the manifestation of old age and death.

verses.pali: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātuyā nirodho …pe… jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo;
verses.english: The cessation of the earth element,

verses.pali: yo viññāṇadhātuyā nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
verses.english: and the consciousness element is the cessation of suffering, the settling of diseases, and the disappearance of old age and death.”
